separation: WSP138 already reserved for lazy exact causal speed optimization, a different study. WSP139 is a prospective query-blind generalization experiment; do not share WSP138 seeded source, code or results.
hypothesis: Can exactly unchanged WSP137 source-blind active 4+28 intervention selection improve causal prediction on POST-ACTION selected genuinely unqueried common inputs and previously unexposed conditional-switch composition without knowing future question locations? Test same-information symbolic parity, cold retention and off-family safety.

source.domain: 64 public six-bit typed action contexts per world, all available to both policies BEFORE choosing; never pre-exclude or disclose held query positions
source.denied: all other seeds including 210800..210863,211800..211863,212800..212863,213800..213863,214800..214863 and ALL historical WSP117–138 cohort seeds; deny before RNG
source.source_wiring: SHA256-seeded WSP139|FAMILY|SEED, randomly permute six bits, hidden AND/OR/XOR/XNOR pairwise gates; known third gate and parity p4 or p4&p5, unfamiliar majority(g1,g2,p4) XOR p5, switch (p4?g1:g2) XOR p5, off cross-interactions p0&p2 XOR p1&p3 XOR p0&p4 XOR p1&p5 XOR p4 XOR p5
source.budgets: 32 distinct charged action effects per policy per new world, 28 worlds and 2 policies = 1792 actual source calls; no effects on 4 relabel worlds
source.first_use: Original CausalGym/MDP/DTR prohibited, no live sources

policy.active: BYTE-IDENTICAL WSP137 ActivePolicy from qualified parent SHA, choose over all64 public x, first 4 fixed then 28 adaptive; 256 SHA256-ranked generic source-blind candidates; no source/evaluator/oracle import, no changed algorithm or knowledge of which future questions asked
policy.fixed: EXACT WSP135 N.schedule fixed 32 x; all64 equally legal
policy.inference: EXACT WSP135 N.fit/N.predict, 17640 already supplied structural templates and learned lookup effects, frozen 80% participating and 90% agreement
policy.controls: Independent WSP137 symbolic fit/predict on same32, conventional fully fitted CART depth6 same32, source-blind NO_UPDATE, privileged source-grammar oracle only on known/majority as diagnostic not chooser
policy.prior: No post-result learned representation update/threshold adjustment

evaluation.primary: After BOTH arms have completed 32 paid actions, ALL 64 outputs from both models frozen. Scorer computes x unqueried by BOTH policies; independently SHA256-ranks these x with WSP139|POSTACTION|SEED|X and selects up to12 for future paired scoring. Choosers were never given any held-set restriction or future question identifiers.
evaluation.insufficient: If ANY of 28 worlds has <8 joint unqueried positions, record EVALUATION_CAPACITY_FAIL and research NO_GO; do not exclude worlds, retry, expand budget or use an alternative denominator posthoc.
evaluation.paired_eval: Compare identical held x within each world. Report per-world counts and weighted totals separately for known8, unfamiliar8, switch8, off4, not 192 independent world replications.
evaluation.secondary: Also score ALL 32 arm-specific unqueried x descriptively. Do not present seen/training x as held-out. Report action intersection size and selected-query digest.
evaluation.transfers: 4 zero-call opaque-ID relabels, 64 predictions each per policy; require 256/256 bit-identical to original source-trained readout, explicitly distinguish accuracy.
evaluation.memory: Earlier known-world 64 predictions identical after training unfamiliar, switch and off worlds; cold reproduction of learned snapshots/checksums without source access.

frozen_gates.status: DEVELOPMENT_POSTACTION_QUERYBLIND_SUPPORTED if all thresholds, min8 per world, custody, parity and retention pass; otherwise DEVELOPMENT_POSTACTION_QUERYBLIND_NO_GO

limitations.mechanism: Active action selection may improve causal inference within 17640 supplied structural templates; not new computational primitive discovery or native weight admission
limitations.statistics: Even if output paired counts large, only 8 independent synthetic source worlds per positive family; report per-world deltas, do not claim independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS
limitations.selection: Joint unseen scoring is post-action and hides query positions, but conditional on both policies' action sets, not an unconditional IID future-context experiment
limitations.unavailable: No independent fully trained deep baseline, matched process-energy, authentic grounded causal first-use/owner acceptance; engineering PASS not SCIENTIFIC_PASS
limitations.authority: No merged PR, accepted main, controller, runner, scheduler, paid API, source original first-use or native acceptance
